content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My lights blink replies when I think questions. It feels like coded answers.
I can’t verify coded replies from lights. What’s the pattern—blink count per minute, or on/off after certain appliances start?
I notice it when the heater kicks in, but also other times.
Heaters and large appliances draw power that can affect lighting. Noting exact start times for the heater against blink moments can show correlation.
Sometimes it happens with no heater.
Logging across an hour with all major appliances off, then repeating with them on, provides a contrast set.
Then you could compare frequency and duration across conditions to see whether it’s uniform or tied to load changes.
